title.zh: 【Paradigm CTO：内置 JIT 编译的新 EVM 已完成审计】
title.en: 【Paradigm CTO：内置 JIT 编译的新 EVM 已完成审计】

current_state.zh: Paradigm has open-sourced evm2, an audited Rust EVM with built-in JIT compilation that claims up to 2x the execution speed of revm and allows customizing opcodes, gas rules, transaction types and precompiles, with planned adoption across Foundry, Reth and Tempo.
